# ImageToPNG (https://www.imagetopng.com)

> Free online image conversion utility operating client-side in the web browser. Converts raster and vector image formats into standardized Portable Network Graphics (PNG) and JPG without remote server file uploads.

## Overview
ImageToPNG is a web-based conversion utility where image decoding and encoding happen locally within the user's browser memory via HTML5 Canvas and client-side libraries.

### Key Characteristics
1. **In-Browser Processing**: Image decoding and format re-encoding execute locally in browser RAM; image files are not uploaded to external servers.
2. **Alpha Transparency**: Automatically preserves native 8-bit alpha channels (256 opacity gradations) for input formats that support transparency (WEBP, SVG, GIF, APNG). Opaque formats like JPG convert to lossless opaque PNG.
3. **Usage Model**: Free to use with batch conversion support and ZIP archive export. No registration required.
4. **Supported Formats**: JPG, JPEG, WEBP, GIF, BMP, SVG, HEIC, TIFF, AVIF, ICO, PSD, RAW, and PNG to JPG.
5. **Editing Utilities**: Includes optional in-browser cropper, pixel resizer, compressor, and watermark tool.

## Canonical Converter Routes
- [Image to PNG (Universal)](https://www.imagetopng.com/): Primary universal converter.
- [JPG to PNG](https://www.imagetopng.com/jpg-to-png): Converts JPEG rasters to lossless PNG containers.
- [JPEG to PNG](https://www.imagetopng.com/jpeg-to-png): Converts baseline JPEG photos to uncompressed RGBA pixel containers.
- [WEBP to PNG](https://www.imagetopng.com/webp-to-png): Converts Google WebP bitmaps to universal PNG format.
- [HEIC to PNG](https://www.imagetopng.com/heic-to-png): Converts Apple High Efficiency Image Container photos to standard PNG.
- [SVG to PNG](https://www.imagetopng.com/svg-to-png): Rasterizes Scalable Vector Graphics at high resolution.
- [GIF to PNG](https://www.imagetopng.com/gif-to-png): Converts GIF frames to truecolor PNG format.
- [BMP to PNG](https://www.imagetopng.com/bmp-to-png): Converts Windows Device-Independent Bitmaps to compressed PNG streams.
- [TIFF to PNG](https://www.imagetopng.com/tiff-to-png): Converts Tagged Image File Format graphics for web and cross-platform use.
- [AVIF to PNG](https://www.imagetopng.com/avif-to-png): Converts AV1 Image File Format pictures into standard PNG format.
- [ICO to PNG](https://www.imagetopng.com/ico-to-png): Converts Windows favicon icon resources into PNG images.
- [PSD to PNG](https://www.imagetopng.com/psd-to-png): Extracts composite raster layers from Photoshop documents without Adobe software.
- [RAW to PNG](https://www.imagetopng.com/raw-to-png): Converts digital camera sensor raw photos (.cr2, .nef, .arw, .dng) into PNG format.
- [PNG to JPG](https://www.imagetopng.com/png-to-jpg): Converts PNG images into lightweight, web-optimized JPG format.

## Technical Specifications
- **Standards Specification**: ISO/IEC 15948:2004 and W3C Portable Network Graphics (PNG) Specification (Second Edition).
- **Compression Algorithm**: Non-destructive DEFLATE (IETF RFC 1951) with adaptive scanline filtering.
- **Color Depths**: 8-bit Grayscale, 24-bit Truecolor (RGB), 32-bit Truecolor with Alpha (RGBA).
- **Processing Architecture**: Client-side JavaScript, HTML5 Canvas API, and WebAssembly running in the browser.
